title: `python -m tqdm --log` with a missing or invalid level raises `IndexError` / `AttributeError`
Invalid hex `colour='#00ff0g'` raises `ValueError` instead of the unknown-colour warning
stdout: Bug found: ValueError raised when passing an invalid hex colour code.

title: `tqdm.pandas`: empty DataFrame raises `ZeroDivisionError`, and `total=` only applies once
script:
import pandas as pd
from tqdm import tqdm

tqdm.pandas()
df = pd.DataFrame(columns=["a", "b"])
try:
    df.progress_apply(lambda column: column)
except ZeroDivisionError:
    print("Empty DataFrame bug found")
    exit(1)

output = StringIO()
tqdm.pandas(
    file=output, ascii=True, leave=True, total=123,
    mininterval=0, miniters=1
)

pd.Series([10, 20, 30]).progress_apply(lambda value: value + 1)
first_line = output.getvalue().replace("\r", "\n").strip().split("\n")[-1]
output.seek(0)
output.truncate(0)
pd.Series([10, 20, 30, 40]).progress_apply(lambda value: value + 1)
second_line = output.getvalue().replace("\r", "\n").strip().split("\n")[-1]

if "3/123" in first_line and "4/4" in second_line:
    print("total consumed after the first call bug found")
    exit(1)

exit(0)
